name: couperconf
description: Provides autocompletion, syntax/semantic validation and syntax highlighting for Couper's HCL based configuration file.

languageModelTools.name: couper_lookup_schema
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Looks up a block, attribute, function or variable of the Couper API gateway configuration language (HCL). Returns the description, the allowed parent blocks, the attributes and child blocks a block accepts, the label rule, attribute types and allowed values, variable properties, and links to the documentation and to examples. Use it before you suggest or explain Couper configuration, and to check whether a name exists. For an unknown name the result lists similar names.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Look up blocks, attributes, functions and variables of the Couper configuration.

name.description: The exact name, for example "backend", "origin", "jwt_sign" or "request".

kind.description: Restricts the lookup to one kind. Omit it to search all kinds.

languageModelTools.name: couper_validate_config
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Checks a Couper configuration (HCL) with the rules the editor diagnostics use: unknown blocks and attributes, wrong nesting, missing or invalid labels, attribute value types, allowed values, unknown functions and variables, and endpoint paths. Pass the configuration as text, or the uri of a .hcl file in the workspace; without input it checks the active editor. Returns one line per problem with line number, severity and message, or confirms that no problems were found. It does not run Couper and finds no problems beyond the schema.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Check a Couper configuration for schema problems.

uri.description: The uri or absolute path of a Couper configuration file. Ignored when text is given.

languageModelTools.name: couper_search_docs
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Searches the index of the Couper documentation at docs.couper.io for pages about a topic. Returns up to five pages with title, section, URL and summary. Use it to find the page for a block, a feature or a concept, then read it with couper_read_docs_page when the schema lookup is not enough. Needs network access.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Find pages in the Couper documentation.

query.description: Words that describe the topic, for example "jwt access control" or "error handler".

languageModelTools.name: couper_read_docs_page
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Reads a page of the Couper documentation and returns its text with tables and code examples, cut off after about 12,000 characters. Only URLs below https://docs.couper.io are accepted; take them from couper_search_docs or from the docs field of couper_lookup_schema. Needs network access.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Read a page of the Couper documentation.
